headline: The Junta will lower taxes in 2027 for home purchases in Andalusia
summary: The Andalusian regional government plans lower taxes on home purchases in 2027. The limit for reduced rates is expected to rise to 200,000 euros, according to the economy councillor.
why: Transfer taxes on property purchases affect housing demand and transaction volumes in regional real estate markets.
